cer_bossmenu.changelog: [cer_bossmenu v1.4.3] Adds a visual interface for role-based access control, allowing admins to configure minimum ranks for all menu sections and actions.

cer_elevators.changelog: [cer_elevators v1.2.0] Introduces a 3D point capture system, database integration, sounds, Dispatch integration, admin interface, job restrictions, animations, and an interactive panel with theme support.
